decisions.reason: The black-finish drainage range builds directly on the firm's existing metal finishing and drainage knowledge, and its upgrade to a dedicated page indicates successful assimilation and low drop risk.
The seamless shower channel is close to the firm's core metal fabrication and drainage expertise, and its stable dedicated web presence suggests the firm can interpret results and improve it.

The pump-drain channel incorporates pump technology less related to the firm's metalworking base, and the prior failure of the pump-assisted Product C signals weaker absorptive capacity, though its own page suggests continued support.
